values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/prettylake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Pretty Lake State Forest Campground, Luce: rustic, open all year, Muskallonge Lake SP 906-658-3338, 18 sites, $20, reservable no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 18 drive-in sites in the main loop, 'suitable for tents and trailers of all sizes' (no maximum length posted), plus 8 walk-in/paddle-in sites (#19-26) 0.8-1.5 mi out along the Pretty Lake Pathway and chain of lakes. The amenity table counts the 18.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/prettylake ('this rustic campground offers 18 sites suitable for tents and trailers of all sizes'; 'there are eight walk-in/paddle-in sites (sites #19-#26) along the Pretty Lake Pathway'; 'The farthest walk is about 1.5 miles ... the shortest is about 0.8 miles') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (18 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic campground in the Pretty Lake Quiet Area (non-motorized use only on Pretty Lake and its seven-lake chain), ~25 mi NW of Newberry via M-123 and County Roads 407 and 416. Only the 18 main-loop sites are drive-in; the walk-in/paddle-in sites lie along the Pretty Lake Pathway, with some short portages. Day-use picnic area; carry-in access ~50 yards from the parking area. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max (confirmed, derived -> manual); 26 sites = 18 drive-in 'suitable for tents and trailers of all sizes' + 8 walk-in/paddle-in (confirmed drive-in for the main loop). Season 'open all year' already manual, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; ORV operation 'no'. Phone 906-658-3338 matches. No road warning on the page. Note trimmed of field restatements.
